title: Thornton F. Bradshaw Professor of Public Policy, Decision Science, and Management
affiliation: Thornton F. Bradshaw Professor of Public Policy, Decision Science, and Management
bio: Dr. Jennifer Lerner holds the Thornton F. Bradshaw Professorship of Public Policy, Management, and Decision Science at the Harvard Kennedy School, where she is the first psychological scientist in the School’s history to be awarded tenure. She also holds appointments in Harvard’s Department of Psychology and its Institute for Quantitative Social Sciences.
research_interests: Training & Labor Decision Making & Negotiation Public Leadership & Management
